ext e
  simp [coeff_hasseDeriv, notMem_support_iff.1
    (notMem_support_of_degreeOf_lt j (s := e + d) (h.trans_le (by simp)))]
abstract_premise: forall e, Q.coeff e = w e * P.coeff (e+d); forall e, P.coeff (e+d)=0
consequence: Generic shifted coefficient maps vanish on polynomials whose support avoids the upper cone of d. Coordinate-degree corollary remains canonical API.
